nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to defense at the expense of economy or tech. Also avoid transitioning to air without clear evidence of an opponent air threat.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army while increasing production and technology. Maintain your expansion and economy, and add defensive structures if you suspect early pressure.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you see more of the opponent's army composition, especially if they add air units or heavy siege capabilities.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing your ground forces and tech, with a focus on safety against possible early pressure.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence suggests a ground posture with possible early pressure. Representative cues include Marine and Reaper. Their production and technology appear heavy, and they have a heavy economy and expansion.
nodes.own_situation: You have a ground-oriented army with heavy production and technology investment. Economy and expansion are heavy. Defense is light or uncertain, but you have the capacity to strengthen it.
nodes.strategic_reason: Your heavy tech and production advantage can be leveraged to out-scale the opponent if you survive the early game. Maintaining a strong economy supports this.
nodes.title: Early-Mid Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a stable midgame with a strong ground army, key tech upgrades, and a solid economy.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early-mid game, own ground macro posture with heavy production and tech, opponent shows ground cues (Marine, Reaper) with heavy production and tech.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid committing to a specific army composition too early. Also avoid neglecting scouting, as the opponent's intentions are unclear.
nodes.decision_direction: Focus on establishing a solid economy and tech foundation. Scout to determine the opponent's direction. Keep production flexible to adapt to what you see.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate once you have more scouting information about the opponent's army composition and expansion.
nodes.next_state_summary: Transition to a more defined posture based on scouting results.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence is unclear, but a Reaper may have been spotted. Their production is moderate, technology heavy, and they have a heavy economy.
nodes.own_situation: Your army composition is not yet defined, but you are investing heavily in technology and have a moderate production. Economy is heavy, but expansion is uncertain.
nodes.strategic_reason: Early game is about information and infrastructure. Heavy tech investment gives you options, but you need to know the opponent's plan to choose the right response.
nodes.title: Early Game Tech Focus with Unknown Opponent
nodes.transition_goal: Gather enough information to choose a clear strategic direction, whether ground, air, or a mix.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early game, own posture unknown but heavy tech, opponent unknown with possible Reaper scout, moderate production.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid engaging Siege Tanks without a plan. Also avoid over-investing in a single unit type that can be hard-countered.
nodes.decision_direction: Strengthen your ground forces and consider adding units that counter Siege Tanks, such as Immortals or air support. Maintain map presence and watch for drops.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choices, such as Battlecruisers or Ghosts, which may require different responses.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue to develop a balanced ground army with tech upgrades and potential for air transition if needed.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence shows a ground army with Marines, Marauders, Medivacs, and possibly Siege Tanks. They have heavy production and tech, and a strong economy.
nodes.own_situation: You have a solid ground army including Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Warp Prisms. Production and tech are heavy, and your economy is strong.
nodes.strategic_reason: The opponent's composition is ground-heavy, so a strong ground army with proper support can hold. Your tech advantage allows for flexible counters.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Army with Siege Potential
nodes.transition_goal: Build a composition that can break a siege line or force the opponent to engage on your terms.
nodes.trigger_summary: Midgame, own ground army with heavy tech, opponent ground with SiegeTank and Medivac, heavy production.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid letting your Templar get sniped. Also avoid being too passive, as the opponent may try to out-macro you.
nodes.decision_direction: Leverage your High Templar for storm and feedback. Continue to increase production and tech, and consider adding Colossus or air units for additional splash damage.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's late-game tech, such as Battlecruisers or Liberators, which may require air counters.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue to develop your army and tech, preparing for a potential late-game confrontation.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence shows a ground army with Marines, Marauders, and Medivacs. They have heavy production and tech, and a strong economy.
nodes.own_situation: You have a strong ground army including Zealots, Stalkers, High Templar, and Sentries. Defense is moderate, and you have heavy production and tech.
nodes.strategic_reason: High Templar provide strong area denial and can shut down Medivac healing. Your tech advantage allows for powerful late-game compositions.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Ground with Templar Tech
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a powerful late-game army with a mix of ground and possibly air units, and secure a decisive advantage.
nodes.trigger_summary: Late-midgame, own ground army with High Templar, opponent ground with Medivac and heavy production.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid overreacting to a single Marine. Also avoid neglecting scouting, as the opponent could be hiding tech.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to develop your economy and tech. Scout to confirm the opponent's build. Keep your options open for ground or air.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have more scouting information or when the opponent's tech becomes apparent.
nodes.next_state_summary: Transition to a more defined strategy based on the opponent's actions.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence shows a Marine, indicating a ground posture. Their production is moderate, technology heavy, and they have a heavy economy.
nodes.own_situation: Your army composition is not yet defined, but you have heavy tech investment and moderate production. Economy is heavy, and expansion is also heavy.
nodes.strategic_reason: Early game is about establishing a strong foundation. The opponent's Marine suggests a ground-oriented build, but you need more information to commit.
nodes.title: Early Game Ground Scout with Marine
nodes.transition_goal: Gain a clear picture of the opponent's strategy and choose a suitable response.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early game, own unknown posture, opponent shows Marine with heavy tech, moderate production.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order.
opening.opening_summary: A Protoss opening that emphasizes heavy technology and production while maintaining a strong economy, with a ground-leaning army composition that can adapt to air if needed.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a technology / economy / production posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
